label: r4c3
name: pure frames 2ep 32 minibatches
hypothesis: Starts from r3c5 and changes one thing: 16 minibatches become 32 (64 samples each). That doubles the gradient steps at the same sample count and lr 2e-3, which should speed the late refinement where training success is about 0.95. Refuted if dev drops clearly below 0.9, which would mean noisier small minibatches hurt.
